name: RichMerchants
title: Rich Merchants - More Ore, Arrows & Bolts (native port)
author: L-Sypniewski (native port). Original mod: tailwindtom
description: Every trader carries 3x more ore, arrows and bolts - configurable 1x-100x with in-game sliders (Settings, Game, Rich Merchants) - so merchants stay useful buyers and sellers all game long. Covers every trader, chapter restock and difficulty. Native AngelScript port of Rich Merchants by tailwindtom (Nexus Mods #161).
